boxes.name: add_recording_chapter
boxes.label: Add recording chapter
boxes.help: Adds a chapter marker to the file being recorded (needs a format with chapters, like Hybrid MP4)

boxes.name: split_recording_file
boxes.label: Split recording file
boxes.help: Goes on recording in a new file (needs file splitting switched on in OBS's recording settings)

boxes.name: send_stream_caption
boxes.label: Send stream caption
boxes.help: Sends caption text (CEA-608) with the stream
